backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining user profiles, schools, submissions, and access‑controlled admin/user operations with authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature-to-file mapping listing implemented features, related frontend files, components, and test IDs for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file for build and documentation use.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file mounting the React app and loading the main TSX entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration with role-based routing, Internet Identity gating, and layout shell.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Comple: Renders donut charts showing completion rates of submission fields over a selectable time range.
frontend/src/components/analytics/Perfor: Analytics wrapper combining time-range selection, performance trend line charts, and completion donuts.
Filters submissions by time range, computes daily average scores, and renders them in a Recharts line chart.
frontend/src/components/analytics/TimeRa: Provides a dropdown to switch between 7‑day and 30‑day time ranges.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access‑denied message with options to return to the dashboard or sign out.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginGate.t: Shows a login screen prompting users to authenticate with Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/director/Leaderb: Renders a ranked table of schools with submission counts and navigation to school details.
frontend/src/components/director/StatsCa: Displays cards showing total active schools, today's submissions, and average performance, with loading states.
frontend/src/components/layout/Dashboard: Wraps dashboard pages in a sidebar layout and provides a main content area.
frontend/src/components/layout/SidebarNa: Provides sidebar navigation with role‑based menu items and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileH: Shows a principal’s profile info including name, school, and region in a styled header card.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Form for creating a user profile with name, school, and region selection, submitting via a save mutation.
frontend/src/components/submissions/Dail: Form component for creating daily submissions, handling attendance inputs, activity checkboxes, photo upload, and submission via mutation.
frontend/src/components/submissions/Subm: Displays detailed breakdown of a submission’s scores and loads the attendance photo on demand.
Shows a sortable table of past submissions with scores and opens a dialog to view detailed submission information.
frontend/src/components/uploads/Attendan: Handles image selection, validation, preview, upload progress, and outputs an ExternalBlob for attendance photos.
frontend/src/constants/regions.ts: Provides a static list of region IDs, names, and codes.
frontend/src/constants/uploads.ts: Defines max upload file size and allowed image MIME types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRole.ts: Determines the user’s auth role by querying the backend actor and exposes admin/user status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, loading identity from storage and offering login and clear functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, submissions, schools, and dashboard data via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS layers and theme variables for light and dark modes, applying global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the root component.
frontend/src/pages/director/DirectorDash: Displays director dashboard with stats, top schools leaderboard, and analytics using fetched submissions and school data.
frontend/src/pages/director/PrincipalDet: Shows detailed information for a specific school and its principal, including stats and recent submissions.
frontend/src/pages/director/PrincipalMan: Provides UI to create schools and assign principals, and lists active schools with management controls.
frontend/src/pages/kepsek/KepsekDashboar: Principal-facing dashboard for submitting daily reports, viewing history, and managing profile setup.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Utility functions for formatting dates and times and converting strings to nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routing), storing/retrieving them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, typography, container queries, and Inter as the default font.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, requirements, existing features, and architectural notes for the SHQ Kepsek Daily Performance Tracker web app.
